sources.title: BCM 104 product page and technical data (Neumann)

notes: Condenser microphone. Output: XLR (the technical data lists the matching cable connector as XLR 3 F, so the microphone side is XLR male). Needs phantom power. Phantom power: P48 (IEC 61938) per the technical data. Switches from the manufacturer's product page; they shape the sound only and do not block the signal. The switches are hidden under the headgrille.
